name: merger-agreement
description: Drafts U.S. merger agreements for M&A transactions covering merger structure and mechanics, consideration, equity treatment, reps and warranties, covenants, closing conditions, termination, and indemnification. Use when drafting or revising a merger agreement, negotiating statutory/triangular/reverse mergers, or handling purchase price, earnouts, escrow/holdback, MAE, HSR clearance, or closing deliverables.
